title: Set up the way I actually work

messages.content: Interview me and write the answers into my Soul, User and Agents files. Ask everything you need in one go — I would rather do this once.

segments.delta: Before I rewrite anything, twenty questions. Most are one tap; the last one is open.

questions.question: How should the morning brief reach you?
questions.details: It is built at 07:30 either way — this is only about delivery.

options.label: Telegram
options.description: One message, readable on the lock screen.

options.label: A PDF plus a short Telegram summary

questions.question: How long should it be?

options.label: As long as the day warrants

questions.question: What counts as worth reporting?

options.label: Anything that changes a decision this week

questions.question: Funding rounds and hiring news?
How many sources before a claim goes in?
questions.details: A press release does not count as one — the filing behind it does.

options.label: One is enough if it is primary

questions.question: Which language should the brief be written in?

options.label: Match whichever language I asked in

questions.question: When should the workday be considered over?
May I schedule things before 09:00?

options.label: Only if I asked for that time specifically

questions.question: What should happen on a quiet hour?
questions.details: The hourly deploy check, when nothing is wrong.

questions.question: Where do phone notifications belong?

options.label: Nothing — I will open the app

questions.question: How should I handle a task that turns out bigger than asked?

options.label: Do it and say what changed
Do the asked part, list the rest

questions.question: Confirm before sending a message to another person?
Default run mode for new procedures?
questions.details: Workflow spawns sub-agents; single is one conversation start to finish.

questions.question: How much should the feed show mid-turn?

options.label: Every tool call and activity card
Clean on the phone, verbose on the desktop

questions.question: When the nightly reflection scores a turn, whose scores count?

options.label: Mine plus the model’s own review

questions.question: Which day should the weekly review land on?
What should the weekly review lead with?

options.label: What changed since the last review

questions.question: How long should a receipt stay in the workspace after filing?

options.label: Delete it once the row is written

questions.question: What should I do when two instructions in your Soul file disagree?
Anything else I should hold onto before I write this down?
questions.details: Whatever you type here goes into the User document verbatim.
questions.other_description: Type it and it lands in brain/identity/user.md.

segments.delta:
Written. Here is what changed:

**brain/identity/soul.md** — brief capped at 150 words, funding and hiring cut, two named sources per claim, English regardless of the question’s language. On a contradiction inside this file I stop and ask rather than resolving it myself.

**brain/identity/user.md** — day ends 18:00, nothing scheduled before 09:00 unless you named the time, and Tuesday mornings are blocked until 11:00.

**brain/prefrontal/agents.md** — a task that grows gets done and reported, messages to other people are always confirmed, and the weekly review moves to Sunday morning and leads with what changed since the last one.

Two answers I did **not** write down as rules, because they are settings rather than instructions: the run mode stays per-procedure, and the feed stays clean on the phone and verbose on the desktop. Both are switches in Settings, and putting them in a markdown file would give you two places to change one thing.
